name: @pm/qwik
description: The qwik variant (editorial-build slice D): resumability, on the official cloudflare-workers integration. REQUEST-TIME — trays are fetched through the edge Worker per request via this Worker's own pm-edge service binding (ADR-0002 §7); serves /qwik/* through the composed origin.

scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-build.mjs && pnpm run build.client && pnpm run build.server
